The algorithm only needs a **local certificate**. Once a stab region collapses, earlier anchors are done - no global rebuild on every arrival.

## Invariant

For each new point:

2. Intersect with the stab region implied by later samples.
3. When the intersection empties, commit and move on.

That local check is enough. Earlier decisions stay valid because the wedge only shrinks.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
SOTS_ROOT="${SOTS_ROOT:-$ROOT/../simplification-of-trajectory-streams}"
PERSONAL_PORT="${PERSONAL_PORT:-8765}"
DEV_CONFIG="$ROOT/dev-config.json"

PIDS=()

pick_free_port() {
  python3 -c 'import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()'
}

# Kill any process currently listening on the given TCP port.
free_port() {
  local port="$1"
  local pids
  pids="$(lsof -tiTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then
    echo "Freeing port ${port} (pids: ${pids//$'\n'/ })"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 0.5
  fi
}

write_dev_config() {
  python3 - "$DEV_CONFIG" "$@" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
config = {}
for arg in sys.argv[2:]:
    card_id, url = arg.split("=", 1)
    config[card_id] = {"embedUrl": url}
path.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2) + "\n")
PY
}

cleanup() {
  for pid in "${PIDS[@]:-}"; do
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  rm -f "$DEV_CONFIG"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

EMBED_ARGS=()

if [[ -f "$SOTS_ROOT/web/server.py" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "${SOTS_PORT:-}" ]]; then
    SOTS_PORT="$(pick_free_port)"
  fi
  EMBED_ARGS+=("sots=http://127.0.0.1:${SOTS_PORT}")
else
  echo "SOTS repo not found at $SOTS_ROOT (glimpse embed will be unavailable)."
  SOTS_PORT=""
fi

if ((${#EMBED_ARGS[@]})); then
  write_dev_config "${EMBED_ARGS[@]}"
fi

if ! command -v browser-sync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "browser-sync not found. Run: pnpm install" >&2
  exit 1
fi

free_port "$PERSONAL_PORT"
echo "Personal page (live reload): http://127.0.0.1:${PERSONAL_PORT}"

browser-sync start \
  --server "$ROOT" \
  --port "$PERSONAL_PORT" \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --open local \
  --no-ui \
  --no-notify \
  --files \
    "$ROOT/index.html" \
    "$ROOT/styles.css" \
    "$ROOT/main.js" \
    "$ROOT/projects/**/*" \
    "$ROOT/posts/**/*" \
    "$ROOT/writing/**/*" \
    "$ROOT/assets/**/*" \
    "$ROOT/dev-config.json" \
  --ignore "node_modules" \
  --ignore ".git" \
  --ignore ".lavish" \
  --ignore ".agents" \
  &
PIDS+=($!)

if [[ -n "$SOTS_PORT" ]]; then
  if [[ -x "$SOTS_ROOT/web/.venv/bin/python" ]]; then
    SOTS_PYTHON="$SOTS_ROOT/web/.venv/bin/python"
  else
    SOTS_PYTHON="python3"
  fi
  echo "SOTS visualizer: http://127.0.0.1:${SOTS_PORT}"
  (
    cd "$SOTS_ROOT/web"
    PORT="$SOTS_PORT" HOST=127.0.0.1 "$SOTS_PYTHON" server.py
  ) &
  PIDS+=($!)
fi

wait
